messages:
Jason (AE): Hey all — SoundWave wants to sign an order after the POC. Legal asked for a conditional signer rule: if PO amount >= $50,000 then Finance sign-off required, otherwise AE can countersign. Can we map that into our eSign flow?
Priya (Solutions): +1. Also need the POC env expiry date on the order form and a line for 'trial usage credits' so billing knows not to charge immediately.
Elena (Legal): We redlined the MSA and DPA to add the conditional approval clause. Main callout: we want the SLA attachment included as part of the order form by reference (so signature binds it).
Mark (Finance): From finance perspective, conditional signer is fine but we need PO number and net-45 by default. If customer requests net-60 we need a finance approval ticket.
Jason (AE): @Elena can you paste the exact language we put in the MSA for the conditional signer? Need to include in the order form notes for DocuSign.
Elena (Legal): Sure — suggested short phrase to insert into order form footer: "Signer routing: For any Order Form with Total Consideration >= $50,000, a Finance signatory (Finance Director or delegate) is required prior to activation." Keep it short.
Priya (Solutions): For DocuSign routing we can use an envelope conditional rule. Example we use elsewhere:
```
{
  "routing_rules": [
    {"if": "order_total >= 50000", "signer": "finance@redwood.com"},
    {"else": "ae@redwood.com"}
  ]
}
```
Jason (AE): Nice. Who owns configuring that in the template? I can upload the order form but I don't have rights to set routing rules.
Mark (Finance): We can designate finance@redwood.com as the fallback signer. Finance prefers a single person per deal rather than a pool, to make audits easier.
Elena (Legal): Also add a visible checkbox on the order form: "I acknowledge this Order Form incorporates the MSA, DPA, and SLA by reference." That helps with enforceability.
Priya (Solutions): For the POC we need one more thing: customer asked for IP carveout language for deliverables produced during the POC. Legal, can you confirm a short addendum we can attach to order form?
Elena (Legal): We'll add a 1-paragraph POC Addendum. I'll send the text in a sec. For now mark the order form with `POC_ADDENDUM_PENDING`.
deploy-bot: Deployed new order-form template (v3.2) to staging at 2026-03-21T14:12:01Z :rocket:
Jason (AE): Thanks @deploy-bot. Priya / Mark / Elena — can we aim to have final doc + template configured by EOD tomorrow? Customer is expediting sign-off next week.
Priya (Solutions): I'll provision the POC instance today and attach credentials to the order form notes.
Mark (Finance): I'll pre-approve net-45 on our side; if they ask for net-60 escalate to me.
Elena (Legal): I'll push the redlines and the POC addendum to the shared folder and ping you a link.
Jason (AE): Perfect. Quick checklist for me to circle back: 1) Elena — MSA/DPA redline + POC addendum 2) Priya — POC env & order form note 3) Mark — finance signatory email and payment terms 4) Ops — configure DocuSign routing rule. If anyone can't hit EOD tomorrow call it out now.
Priya (Solutions): I can do mine today.
Mark (Finance): On it.
Elena (Legal): Will deliver by COB tomorrow.
Jason (AE): Awesome — thanks team :thumbsup:
